lead.headline: Big Stric clawed back. Now it’s Justin Jefferson or bust.
lead.dek: Ashton Jeanty and Geno Smith cut the deficit in half in the late window. The champ still leads 141.32 to 126.7, and each side has exactly one starter left: Jefferson for Big Stric Energy, Brock Purdy for Maye I touch your TDs?.
lead.pull: One receiver, one quarterback, and a tight end slot that still reads 0.0.
body: 4:48 PM, and Big Stric Energy is still breathing. At lunch this looked like a franchise playing out the string. Then Ashton Jeanty went for 27.9 on a 12.66 projection, Geno Smith closed at 19.44, and the hole got cut in half. Scoreboard: Maye I touch your TDs? 141.32, Big Stric 126.7.

Now it’s a duel. Big Stric has one starter left, Justin Jefferson, projected for 18.09. The champ has one left, Brock Purdy, projected for 17.63. The live projection says 158.95 to 144.79, the champ by 14.16, and the champ is 84.2% to win. Translation: Jefferson has to outscore Purdy by more than 14 points. Not impossible. Not likely either.

And the slot everybody will point to is still sitting there. Big Stric started Dalton Kincaid, Kincaid was Out with the thumb, and the tight end line went in the books at 0.0. The bench had no tight end; Tucker Kraft was on bye. Here’s the part that hurts: the champ’s tight end, Michael Mayer, the most-added player in football this week, gave the champ 1.4. That’s it. 1.4. And 1.4 still beat Big Stric’s tight end.

The bench didn’t help the mood either. Saquon Barkley put 13.5 on the pine while Braelon Allen started and finished at 9.4. Josh Allen closed at 14.16 against a 24.67 projection. Tyler Bass kicked in 17.0, which is the only reason this is still a conversation.

My read: 15.8% is fair. This is the game between two 2-8 teams that decides who keeps a pulse in the playoff race; Big Stric sits at 17.7% to make it, the champ at 25.2%. Everything now rides on one receiver. If Jefferson goes off, Kincaid becomes a footnote. If he doesn’t, Kincaid is the headline.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom took the lead, and Jonah Coleman did it
quick_hits.body: At lunch Cherry Blossom trailed. Now it leads Bad things man bad things 155.0 to 136.16 and is 96.6% to win. The morning call to start Jonah Coleman over Brock Bowers paid 34.9 on a 17.46 projection, Travis Kelce added 25.4, and Christian McCaffrey and Tee Higgins haven’t even played. Bad things has Kirk Cousins and Evan McPherson left and a 160.28 live projection against 193.86. Call of the day, and it isn’t close.

quick_hits.headline: Poochinski is done; Santa Clara’s Finest is playing for the record books
quick_hits.body: Poochinski leads 175.04 to 77.86 and is 100% with Chase Brown and the San Francisco 49ers D/ST still to go. Santa Clara’s Finest got 15.0 from the Houston Texans D/ST and 16.96 from Bryce Young, while Baker Mayfield’s 19.08 sat on the bench. Joe Burrow and Stefon Diggs are left, and a 117.67 live projection won’t catch 197.64.

quick_hits.headline: deeboliciouskins has three left and doesn’t need any of them
quick_hits.body: deeboliciouskins leads AB81 108.06 to 75.34 and is 100%, with Jayden Daniels, Ja’Marr Chase and new kicker Drew Stevens still to play. DJ Moore’s 23.1 on the bench is a luxury problem. AB81 is down to the Cincinnati Bengals D/ST.

quick_hits.headline: Three teams, two 2-8 records, one last spot
quick_hits.body: Santa Clara’s Finest holds the last playoff spot at 57.1% and is losing this week. Behind it: the champ at 25.2% and Big Stric at 17.7%, and one of them wins this week. Whoever takes the Jefferson-Purdy duel stays in the chase. The other one is probably planning for next season.

quick_hits.headline: Who’s left for tonight and Monday
quick_hits.body: Big Stric: Justin Jefferson. The champ: Brock Purdy. Cherry Blossom: Christian McCaffrey, Tee Higgins. Bad things: Kirk Cousins, Evan McPherson. deeboliciouskins: Jayden Daniels, Ja’Marr Chase, Drew Stevens. Santa Clara’s Finest: Joe Burrow, Stefon Diggs. Poochinski: Chase Brown, the 49ers D/ST. AB81: the Bengals D/ST.

w11-m1.headline: Jefferson vs. Purdy, winner stays alive
w11-m1.blurb: The champ leads 141.32 to 126.7 and is 84.2%. One starter left per side: Justin Jefferson (18.09 projected) for Big Stric, Brock Purdy (17.63) for the champ. Big Stric needs a monster game.

w11-m2.headline: deeboliciouskins with the clock running out
w11-m2.blurb: 108.06 to 75.34, with Jayden Daniels and Ja’Marr Chase still to play. deeboliciouskins projects 158.77 to 81.89 and is 100%.

w11-m3.headline: Cherry Blossom flipped it and still has the bullets
w11-m3.blurb: Cherry Blossom leads 155.0 to 136.16 with McCaffrey and Higgins left. Bad things has Cousins and McPherson. Live projection: 193.86 to 160.28, Cherry Blossom 96.6%.

w11-m4.headline: Poochinski, wire to wire
w11-m4.blurb: Poochinski leads 175.04 to 77.86 and is 100%. Santa Clara’s Finest has Burrow and Diggs left and nothing close to enough runway.

w11-r8-s3.headline: AB81’s last shuffle, due 5:20 PM
w11-r8-s3.blurb: Kyren Williams is on bye. Mike Evans (13.83) or George Kittle (12.36) can slide in through the flex. The game is gone, but the points still count for the record books.

w11-r8-s7.headline: Kittle is still on the bench
w11-r8-s7.blurb: Rhamondre Stevenson is on bye in the flex. George Kittle (12.36) is the answer, deadline Sun 5:20 PM.

w11-r4-s7.headline: The Coleman call: 34.9
w11-r4-s7.blurb: Cherry Blossom sat Brock Bowers and started Jonah Coleman (17.46 projected). Coleman delivered 34.9 and flipped the matchup.

w11-r6-s9.headline: deeboliciouskins found its kicker
w11-r6-s9.blurb: Jason Myers out, Drew Stevens (6.99) in, added at 9:42 AM. He still has to kick.

w11-r2-s8.headline: Burden in for Price
w11-r2-s8.blurb: Poochinski’s first call of the day. Luther Burden III gave it 3.3. The rest of the lineup made it irrelevant.

w11-r2-s10.headline: Poochinski’s 49ers D/ST is still to come
w11-r2-s10.blurb: Added at 12:51 PM for Tyler Higbee, with the Seattle Seahawks D/ST on bye. Projects 7.53.

2026-11-22-m1.blurb: Poochinski cut Aaron Rodgers (16.61 projected) for Kaelon Black (4.64) at 9:23 AM. Caleb Williams had the start anyway, but in a two-quarterback league a spare quarterback is worth more than a spare back.

2026-11-22-m2.blurb: deeboliciouskins dropped Kyler Murray, who was Out, for kicker Drew Stevens (6.99) at 9:42 AM. Filled the last hole in the lineup. Clean.

2026-11-22-m3.blurb: Poochinski added the San Francisco 49ers D/ST (7.53) for Tyler Higbee at 12:51 PM, covering the Seattle bye. A defense beats an empty slot every time.
